items.title: Synthetic helpdesk configuration export
items.excerpt: Synthetic fixture. Helpdesk configuration export, 2026-11-03. Billing-tagged tickets are assigned to the queue Billing at all hours. No routing rule depends on time of day. Business hours are Monday to Friday 08:00-17:00 in the Europe/Berlin calendar. Routing rules can use a business-hours condition.

items.title: Synthetic support lead note on the first release
items.excerpt: Synthetic fixture. Support lead note, 2026-11-04. The off-hours rota starts with 2 agents. Billing macros follow in a later spec after question tagging. The rota calendar is kept in the existing scheduling tool.

items.title: Synthetic ticket report for a boundary defect
items.excerpt: Synthetic fixture. Ticket 4812, 2026-11-02: a billing ticket created at 17:00 on Monday stayed unassigned for 15 hours.
